name: an-empty-grid-opens-when-a-row-is-dragged-under-the-address-bar
description: A space with no favourites draws no grid band at rest, so the space name sits right under the address bar. A real cgevent drag from a tab row up into the strip under the address bar must open the grid: the space name and the rows slide down and the drag-tabs-here hint shows. The drop there makes the first favourite. Coordinates come from the DOM, plus the 30px the window sits below the screen top.

actions.expression: (() => { const tiles = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dropzone="favorites"] .fav').length; const rows = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)').querySelectorAll('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow').length; return tiles + ' tiles, ' + rows + ' rows'; })()

(() => { const bar = document.querySelector('#atrium-root > .urlrow').getBoundingClientRect(); const gap = Math.round(document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)').querySelector('.wsname').getBoundingClientRect().top - bar.bottom); return gap <= 16 ? 'tight' : 'gap ' + gap; })()

(() => { const b = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)').querySelector('[data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2) + ',' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2 + 30); })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('#atrium-root > .urlrow').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2) + ',' + Math.round(b.bottom + 5 + 30); })()

(() => { window.__ev = []; for (const t of ['dragstart','dragover','drop','dragend']) { document.addEventListener(t, () => { if (window.__ev[window.__ev.length-1] !== t) { window.__ev.push(t); } }, true); } const orig = chrome.send.bind(chrome); window.__cs = []; chrome.send = (name, args) => { if (name === 'sidebarRowFavorited') { window.__cs.push([name, args]); } return orig(name, args); }; const name = () => document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)').querySelector('.wsname'); const base = name().getBoundingClientRect().top; window.__shift = 0; window.__open = 'closed'; document.addEventListener('dragover', () => requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (window.__ev.includes('drop')) { return; } window.__shift = Math.max(window.__shift, Math.round(name().getBoundingClientRect().top - base)); const hint = document.querySelector('#atrium-root > .favgrid.dropopen .favhint'); if (hint && hint.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0) { window.__open = 'hint'; } }), true); return 'spying'; })()

assertions.desc: gates the drag: no favourites and two rows
at rest the space name sits right under the address bar, with no empty grid band
the drag reached drop and dragend
THE MEASUREMENT: the strip opened the grid and showed its hint
and the space name slid down to make room
the drop made the first favourite
